## Case studies

- [piiguard](https://akhilvallala1.github.io/projects/piiguard/): piiguard is an open-source PII leak guard for sandboxed AI agents that hardens itself with a red team, a coach, and a gate. Winner of Best Use of NemoClaw and OpenShell at the Recursive Agents Hackathon.
- [AgentShield](https://akhilvallala1.github.io/projects/agentshield/): AgentShield is an open-source guardrail proxy for agent-to-agent traffic. An async LLM auditor turns missed PII into tested regex rules, and rules that misfire on live traffic are retired, with human approval both ways.
- [Conduit](https://akhilvallala1.github.io/projects/conduit/): Conduit is an open-source, proxy-first AI gateway: one OpenAI-compatible API, an enforced six-stage pipeline, complexity-based model routing that cut cost 50.8% vs all-Opus, PII and injection guards, and CI-gated evals.
